schema.help: Signs include street names, maps and directions, and also audible or tactile information for blind and low-vision people.

options.text: I don't use signs, so they make no difference to me
They help when I need them, and I rarely get lost
I rely on them to find the way, exits and crossings
I often stop to check where I am, because signs are unclear or missing
Signs are so poor that I can only find my way with a phone app

schema.text: How much do street signs help you find your way on foot?

ar.#How much do street signs help you find: ما مدى مساعدة لافتات الشوارع لك في معرفة طريقك مشيًا؟
ar.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: لا أستخدم اللافتات، لذا لا فرق عندي
ar.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: أتوقف غالبًا لأعرف أين أنا، لأن اللافتات غير واضحة أو غير موجودة
ar.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: أعتمد عليها لمعرفة الطريق والمخارج والمعابر
ar.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: اللافتات سيئة لدرجة أنني لا أجد طريقي إلا بتطبيق على الهاتف
ar.#Signs include street names, maps and di: تشمل اللافتات أسماء الشوارع والخرائط والاتجاهات، وكذلك معلومات صوتية أو لمسية للمكفوفين وضعاف البصر.
ar.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: تساعدني عندما أحتاج إليها ونادرًا ما أضل الطريق

de.#How much do street signs help you find: Wie sehr helfen Ihnen Straßenschilder, zu Fuß den Weg zu finden?
de.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Ich nutze keine Schilder, für mich machen sie keinen Unterschied
de.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Ich halte oft an, um zu prüfen, wo ich bin, weil Schilder unklar sind oder fehlen
de.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Ich verlasse mich darauf, um den Weg, Ausgänge und Übergänge zu finden
de.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: Die Schilder sind so schlecht, dass ich den Weg nur mit einer Handy-App finde
de.#Signs include street names, maps and di: Zu den Schildern gehören Straßennamen, Karten und Wegweiser sowie akustische oder tastbare Informationen für blinde und sehbehinderte Menschen.
de.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Sie helfen, wenn ich sie brauche, und ich verlaufe mich selten

fa.#How much do street signs help you find: تابلوها و علامت‌های خیابان چقدر به شما کمک می‌کنند در پیاده‌روی راه را پیدا کنید؟
fa.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: از علامت‌ها استفاده نمی‌کنم، پس برایم فرقی ندارند
fa.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: اغلب می‌ایستم تا ببینم کجا هستم، چون علامت‌ها نامشخص است یا نیست
fa.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: برای پیدا کردن راه، خروجی‌ها و گذرگاه‌ها به آن‌ها تکیه می‌کنم
fa.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: علامت‌ها آن‌قدر ضعیف است که فقط با اپلیکیشن تلفن راه را پیدا می‌کنم
fa.#Signs include street names, maps and di: علامت‌ها شامل نام خیابان، نقشه و جهت‌ها هستند و همچنین اطلاعات صوتی یا لمسی برای نابینایان و کم‌بینایان.
fa.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: وقتی لازم دارم کمک می‌کنند و به‌ندرت راه را گم می‌کنم

fr.#How much do street signs help you find: Dans quelle mesure les panneaux dans la rue vous aident-ils à trouver votre chemin à pied ?
fr.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Je n'utilise pas les panneaux, donc cela ne change rien pour moi
fr.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Je m'arrête souvent pour vérifier où je suis, car les panneaux sont peu clairs ou absents
fr.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Je m'appuie sur eux pour trouver mon chemin, les sorties et les passages
fr.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: Les panneaux sont si mauvais que je ne trouve mon chemin qu'avec une appli sur mon téléphone
fr.#Signs include street names, maps and di: Les panneaux comprennent les noms de rues, les plans et les directions, ainsi que des informations sonores ou tactiles pour les personnes aveugles et malvoyantes.
fr.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Ils m'aident quand j'en ai besoin et je me perds rarement

hu.#How much do street signs help you find: Mennyire segítik az utcai táblák, hogy gyalog eligazodjon?
hu.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Nem használom a táblákat, ezért nincs jelentőségük
hu.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Gyakran megállok ellenőrizni, hol vagyok, mert a táblák nem érthetők vagy hiányoznak
hu.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Rájuk támaszkodom az útvonal, a kijáratok és az átkelők megtalálásához
hu.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: A táblák annyira rosszak, hogy csak telefonos alkalmazással találom meg az utat
hu.#Signs include street names, maps and di: A táblák közé tartoznak az utcanevek, térképek és irányjelzések, valamint a vak és gyengénlátó emberek számára készült hang- vagy tapintható információk.
hu.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Segítenek, ha szükségem van rájuk, és ritkán tévedek el

it.#How much do street signs help you find: Quanto ti aiutano i cartelli stradali a trovare la strada a piedi?
it.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Non uso i cartelli, quindi per me non fanno differenza
it.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Mi fermo spesso a controllare dove sono, perché i cartelli sono poco chiari o mancano
it.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Mi affido ai cartelli per trovare la strada, le uscite e gli attraversamenti
it.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: I cartelli sono così scarsi che trovo la strada solo con un'app sul telefono
it.#Signs include street names, maps and di: I cartelli comprendono nomi delle strade, mappe e indicazioni, e anche informazioni sonore o tattili per le persone cieche e ipovedenti.
it.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Mi aiutano quando servono e mi perdo raramente

tr.#How much do street signs help you find: Sokak tabelaları yürürken yolunuzu bulmanıza ne kadar yardımcı oluyor?
tr.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Tabelaları kullanmam, bu yüzden benim için fark etmez
tr.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Tabelalar belirsiz veya eksik olduğu için nerede olduğumu kontrol etmek için sık sık dururum
tr.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Yolu, çıkışları ve geçitleri bulmak için onlara güvenirim
tr.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: Tabelalar o kadar yetersiz ki yolu ancak telefon uygulamasıyla bulabiliyorum
tr.#Signs include street names, maps and di: Tabeler; sokak adlarını, haritaları ve yönleri, ayrıca görme engelli ve az gören kişiler için sesli veya dokunsal bilgileri içerir.
tr.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: İhtiyacım olduğunda yardımcı olurlar ve nadiren kaybolurum
